 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. The matchups for the third round of the League of Legends 2026 World Championship Swiss Stage have been drawn. This round will feature the first two qualification and elimination matches of the Swiss Stage. Unlike the previous matches so far, these matches will be a best-of-three series using fearless draft. Meanwhile, the remaining matches in the 1-1 bracket will continue being a best-of-one.
 Here are the matchups for Round 3 of the Worlds 2026 Swiss Stage:
 Worlds 2026 Swiss Stage Round 3 MatchupsRiot Games
 2-0 Bracket :
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Gen.G (GEN) vs LYON (LYON)
 Dplus Kia (DK) vs Movistar KOI (MKOI)
 The 2-0 bracket will feature two LCK teams going up against an LCS and an LEC team. Gen.G will be facing the LCS' LYON while DK is paired against the LEC's MKOI.
 The match between Gen.G and LYON will see one of the best Western junglers, Kacper " Inspired " Słoma battling Gen.G again. Previously, Inspired pushed Gen.G to their limits while he was playing for FlyQuest. Now, he has another chance to beat Gen.G and give North America a representative at the Knockout Stage. Meanwhile, Gen.G have looked like the most dominant team so far at Worlds 2026. Beating LYON would bring them one step closer to winning the Summoner's Cup this year.
 Dplus Kia will be facing the LEC's Movistar KOI. So far, DK managed to steal wins against their two previous opponents, G2 Esports and T1. Unlike their previous matches, they enter this one as a favorite to win. On the other hand, MKOI have had a fantastic showing at Worlds this year compared to their previous underperformances. This could finally be their chance to redeem themselves for their past failures.
 The two winners of the 2-0 Bracket will be the first teams to qualify for the Worlds 2026 Knockout Stage.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement 1-1 Bracket :
 Top Esports (TES) vs G2 Esports (G2)
 Hanwha Life Esports (HLE) vs Invictus Gaming (IG)
 Karmine Corp (KC) vs Bilibili Gaming (BLG)
 T1 (T1) vs CTBC Flying Oysters (CFO)
 Next, the 1-1 bracket of the third round has many exciting matchups. It features many teams who were considered serious contenders going into Worlds 2026.
 The most exciting matchup in this bracket will be Top Esports facing G2 Esports. These two teams have played against each other many times over the years. This match will be another chapter to their international rivalry.
 Another match to look forward to is Hanwha Life Esports against Invictus Gaming. This match will feature two of the best top laners in history, Choi " Zeus " Woo-je and Kang " TheShy " Seung-lok battling each other. Their last match resulted in Zeus winning his first Worlds. Now, TheShy has a chance to take his revenge.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Finally, the remaining matches are between Karmine Corp versus Bilibili Gaming and T1 vs the CTBC Flying Oysters. BLG seems to have recovered following their shocking loss to MKOI in Round 1. However, KC have a chance to hand the LPL favorites another loss to a European team. Meanwhile, T1 and CFO meet each other again in the Swiss Stage. CFO managed to beat T1 when they met last year. It will be interesting to see if they can do it again.
 0-2 Bracket :
 LOS (LOS) vs Team Secret Whales (TSW)
 Team Liquid Alienware (TLAW) vs Anyone's Legend (AL)
 The 0-2 bracket surprisingly features teams who are the first seeds in their respective regions. This bracket will be life and death for these teams, as a loss would eliminate them from Worlds 2026.
 LOS and Team Secret Whales will be another match between the CBLOL against the LCP. Although these teams come from less established regions, it should nonetheless be an action-packed match.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement On the other hand, Team Liquid Alienware and Anyone's Legend surprised everyone when they dropped to the 0-2 bracket. Both these teams have had a disappointing run at Worlds 2026 so far. However, a win here could be the beginning of either team's comeback story.
 Round 3 of the Worlds 2026 Swiss Stage will begin on October 25, 2026, at 12 PM CDT.
